fact: Presenting Vote 06 for 2018/19 in a statement dated 13 April 2018, the Minister of Safety and Security said the Ministry had rolled out both the E-Policing system and the NamPol Automated Biometric Identification System (N-ABIS) 'to most crucial infrastructures', in line with the Government's E-governance policy and the Ministerial Strategic Plan, and asked N$64,240,000 from the national budget for the Information and Communication Technology programme; no count of stations is given.
title: Vote 06: Ministry of Safety and Security
publisher: Ministry of Safety and Security, Republic of Namibia (published by the Parliament of Namibia)
